statements.text_en: Incoterms EXW Boise; payment terms NET30.

verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26132751 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318780 dated 2026-11-02. It confirms two items: 6,000 pcs CMP-GAM-002 at 6.11 USD for 2026-12-02, and 48,000 pcs CMP-GAM-001 at 10.93 USD for 2026-12-11. The terms are EXW Boise with payment NET30. The document is printed and clean, with no handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict themselves: EXW Boise is stated, and DDP is said not to be agreed, yet freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays these, so the invoice could carry freight, insurance and duty charges the buyer did not expect.
Confirmed quantities and dates are given with no mention of any deviation from the order. The PO quantities and dates are not on this document, so they could not be compared.
Items are listed out of order (00020 before 00010).
The document has no issue date of its own; only the PO date 2026-11-02 appears.
observations: Single-page printed document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Unit of measure for quantities is not stated.
Currency is USD for both lines; line totals are not shown.
